title: Orthogonal Boolean families do not imply a Boolean whole
statement: MO2 is the horizontal sum of two Boolean4 algebras. It is complete and orthomodular but nondistributive. Every indexed pairwise orthogonal family has at most two distinct nonzero elements, lies in one Boolean block, and thus lies in a complete Boolean subortholattice.

statement: Take the four-stratum P4 orthogonality relation with equality incidence and equality open refinement.
